name: Breakdown Momentum (Short Review)
description: Bearish momentum breakdown review where absolute downtrend, bearish signal, market regime, and DQ/liquidity evidence align. Applicable ONLY to F&O/derivatives-eligible instruments.

entryRules.label: Price is below SMA50 — downtrend evidence.
Price is below SMA200 — long-term downtrend confirmation.
Raw or calibrated signal is bearish.
Signal score is strong enough for short-review.
Sector is lagging or weakening — supports bearish setup.
Smart money distribution supports bearish setup.
Instrument must be F&O/derivatives eligible for short-review plans.

exitRules.label: Cover review if data quality becomes unusable or not ready.
Cover review if price reclaims breakdown level — setup is invalidated.
Cover review if market regime shifts from risk-off to risk-on.
Cover review when bearish signal score or direction weakens.
Cover review when price-volume distribution ends.

invalidationRules.label: Invalidate short evidence when data quality is missing, unusable, or not ready.
Invalidate short setup when price reclaims the breakdown support level.
Invalidate short entry when market regime shifts to risk-on.

noiseFilters.label: Data quality is not ready — short-review requires clean data.
Risk-on regime blocks new short-review entries.
Signal reliability is low or noisy.
Cash-only instruments are excluded from short-review plans.

riskRules.label: Use bounded position count in backtests.
Default max holding period for short-review is 90 trading days.
Short-review trailing stop (stop above entry) is conservative.
Requires derivativesEligible=true; cash-only instruments cannot be short-reviewed.

marketGateRules.label: Market gate should be selective or closed (short-review is counter-trend; blocked in strong risk-on).

explanationTemplate: Triggered when bearish trend, signal strength, and F&O eligibility align for a short-review setup.

triggers: Price below SMA50/SMA200 with bearish signal and derivatives-eligible instrument.
blocks: Cash-only (non-derivatives-eligible) instrument; accumulation pattern; risk-on regime; data not ready.
